item.title: Lacy 1.1 (build 4)
item.description:
The lock screen gets a full-screen player.

  • Tap the artwork on the lock screen to open a full-screen player: a big, sharp cover on its own flowing colours
  • Time-synced lyrics in the full-screen player, off by default (Settings → Lock Screen, from LRCLIB)
  • Space plays and pauses, ← and → skip, right on the lock screen
  • Pick where the sound goes from the lock screen
  • Sharper covers for music and YouTube
  • The playing app's icon sits in the lock screen card, with the title and artist centred

item.title: Lacy 1.0 (build 3)
item.description:
Your Mac's notch, alive. The first full release.

  • Now Playing for any app, browsers included: artwork, progress, controls, and a click on the title jumps to the tab or app that's playing
  • Lock screen: a see-through glass Now Playing card while your Mac is locked, and an unlock confirmation in the notch
  • Calendar: today's events at a glance; tap any day or flip months
  • Shelf for files, Ask (Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini), Snake, and Tools: timer, Keep Awake, clipboard history, color picker, mirror, note
  • Battery, Bluetooth, Focus, volume and brightness, shown in the notch
  • Stays out of the way: hidden in full screen until you point at it
  • Automatic updates

item.title: Lacy 0.9.0 (build 2)
item.description:
First public beta build with automatic updates.

  • Calendar: tap any day to see its events, flip months, jump back to today
  • Player: artwork sits beside the title; click the title to jump to the app or browser tab that's playing
  • Full screen: point at the notch to open it
  • Clipboard history is kept across restarts and scrolls with the trackpad
  • Mirror uses the built-in camera reliably
  • Ask: Gemini replaces Google AI
  • Runs on Intel Macs too
